name: Home

sections.heading: Containers built around the cargo, not the catalogue

body.p: We manufacture freight containers and develop container solutions for the way goods actually move. Tell us what you are moving, how it is loaded and where it has to reach, and we work from that.

Standard and specialised configurations are both part of our range. Which one suits you depends on the cargo, the loading method and the route, so we confirm the configuration against your requirement rather than assuming.

sections.heading: Manufacturing and engineering behind the product

body.p: Our established container manufacturing base is at Rewari, Haryana. Design, development and production sit behind what we supply, and every published specification comes from a controlled data sheet for that model.
If a requirement falls outside our standard range, we look at what the cargo needs before saying whether we can make it.

sections.heading: Shivlakha: a rail and logistics platform taking shape

body.p: At Shivlakha in Kachchh, Gujarat, we are developing a rail-linked platform that brings together container and railway wagon manufacturing, a Gati Shakti Terminal and an Inland Container Terminal.
These are separate components at different stages of development. We describe the status of each one rather than treating the platform as a single operational service.

Whether you are specifying a container or testing whether a rail-linked movement makes sense for your cargo, the first step is the same. Send us the cargo type, origin and destination, approximate volume and how it moves today, and we will tell you what needs to be assessed.

name: Company overview

body.p: Kalyani Cast Tech Limited is an engineering and manufacturing company. Our work centres on freight containers, specialised cargo equipment and railway-related applications, with an established container manufacturing base at Rewari, Haryana.
At Shivlakha in Kachchh, Gujarat, we are developing a rail and logistics platform intended to connect manufacturing with cargo handling and rail-linked movement.

Three things occupy most of our attention: the containers we manufacture and the cargo they are built for; the engineering and manufacturing behind them; and the infrastructure we are developing to support rail-linked cargo movement.
We keep the scope and status of each capability and project clear, so customers can tell an established capability from a project still under development.

A workable cargo solution starts with the application. We look at the cargo, its dimensions, how it is loaded and unloaded, the handling constraints, the route, how often it moves and any operating requirement attached to it.
Only then do we confirm which configuration fits. One design does not suit every movement, and we would rather say so early than adjust later.

Rewari, Haryana is our established container manufacturing location. Shivlakha, Kachchh, Gujarat is where our rail and logistics platform is being developed. We describe the two separately because their functions and status are different.

Product information, technical documentation and a direct route to the right team. Where a specification, approval, service or project milestone still needs confirmation, we confirm it before we commit to it.

name: Containers & cargo solutions

sections.heading: Choose by application, not by name alone

body.p: The right container depends on the cargo, its dimensions, how it is loaded and unloaded, the handling available and how it will be transported. We organise our range around those questions so you can find a sensible starting point.
A model name tells you very little until you know what it is being asked to carry.

General-purpose and high-cube options cover the majority of dry freight movements. Dimensions, tare weight, payload, gross weight, construction and applicable standards are taken from the current approved data sheet for the model you are considering.

Our material covers configurations such as dwarf and wider-dwarf containers, open-top, tank, hopper, stainless-steel and other special-cargo designs. The live catalogue identifies which models we currently offer and which remain historical or developmental.

Some configurations are designed around parcel, two-wheeler, three-wheeler and similar application-specific cargo. Suitability depends on the cargo itself, the equipment design, the loading process and the wagon or operating conditions that apply.
Each approved model has a controlled data sheet. If you cannot find a specification for what you need, send us the cargo and application details instead of relying on an older brochure.

name: Cargo opportunities and route evaluation

body.p: A useful first review needs the commodity, origin and destination, approximate volume, shipment frequency, current mode and route, loading arrangement, delivery requirements and any handling or documentation constraint.
Without those, any assessment is guesswork.

The evaluation compares your existing movement with a clearly defined alternative. It accounts for road legs, terminal handling, rail-related charges, container or equipment positioning, dwell time, loading and unloading, documentation, inventory implications and service availability.
Every comparison depends on its assumptions and its tariffs, and we state both.

A cargo enquiry is the start of qualification, not a service commitment. If the movement looks suitable and the route and operating arrangements can be confirmed, the next steps may be detailed discovery, a cost comparison, a proposal and a controlled trial.
Rail is not automatically cheaper or better for every shipment. The right decision depends on cargo volume, distance, route, frequency, handling, reliability requirements and total logistics cost.
We will tell you when road remains the better answer.

name: About Us
seoTitle: About Kalyani Cast Tech Limited | Corporate Profile
meta: Corporate profile of Kalyani Cast Tech Limited (BSE SME: 544023). Engineering freight containers, precision foundry castings, and multimodal terminal logistics.
hero: Engineering and manufacturing capabilities supporting specialised industrial and infrastructure applications.

body.p: Kalyani Cast Tech Limited is an engineering and manufacturing company. Our work centres on freight containers, specialised cargo equipment and railway-related applications, with an established container manufacturing base at Rewari, Haryana.
At Shivlakha in Kachchh, Gujarat, we are developing a rail and logistics platform intended to connect manufacturing with cargo handling and rail-linked movement.

Three things occupy most of our attention: the containers we manufacture and the cargo they are built for; the engineering and manufacturing behind them; and the infrastructure we are developing to support rail-linked cargo movement.
We keep the scope and status of each capability and project clear, so customers can tell an established capability from a project still under development.

A workable cargo solution starts with the application. We look at the cargo, its dimensions, how it is loaded and unloaded, the handling constraints, the route, how often it moves and any operating requirement attached to it.
Only then do we confirm which configuration fits. One design does not suit every movement, and we would rather say so early than adjust later.

Rewari, Haryana is our established container manufacturing location. Shivlakha, Kachchh, Gujarat is where our rail and logistics platform is being developed. We describe the two separately because their functions and status are different.

Product information, technical documentation and a direct route to the right team. Where a specification, approval, service or project milestone still needs confirmation, we confirm it before we commit to it.

name: Products & Applications
seoTitle: Products & Applications | Kalyani Cast Tech Limited
meta: Standard ISO containers, specialised open-top coiltainers, dwarf containers, tank containers, and ISO 1161 specification corner castings engineered in India.
h1: The cargo picks the container. We engineer it.
hero: Container configurations matched to cargo weight, volume, loading method and route restrictions.

sections.heading: Choose by application, not by name alone

body.p: The right container depends on the cargo, its dimensions, how it is loaded and unloaded, the handling available and how it will be transported. We organise our range around those questions so you can find a sensible starting point.
A model name tells you very little until you know what it is being asked to carry.

General-purpose and high-cube options cover the majority of dry freight movements. Dimensions, tare weight, payload, gross weight, construction and applicable standards are taken from the current approved data sheet for the model you are considering.

Our material covers configurations such as dwarf and wider-dwarf containers, open-top, tank, hopper, stainless-steel and other special-cargo designs. The live catalogue identifies which models we currently offer and which remain historical or developmental.

Some configurations are designed around parcel, two-wheeler, three-wheeler and similar application-specific cargo. Suitability depends on the cargo itself, the equipment design, the loading process and the wagon or operating conditions that apply.
Each approved model has a controlled data sheet. If you cannot find a specification for what you need, send us the cargo and application details instead of relying on an older brochure.

name: Engineering, Testing & Quality
seoTitle: Engineering & Quality | Kalyani Cast Tech Limited
meta: In-house container structural testing, optical emission spectrometry, non-destructive testing (NDT), and quality assurance systems at Rewari Works, Haryana.
hero: In-house 3D CAD design, metallurgical spectroscopy, certified non-destructive testing, and in-house ISO 1496 load validation under one roof at Kalyani Cast Tech Limited.

body.p: Quality requirements depend on the product, its intended use and the applicable specification. We provide technical and quality information within the scope verified for the relevant model or process.

Testing equipment, inspection methods, test results and formal certification are different things. We identify the evidence that applies and its scope, rather than implying that a test facility establishes certification for every product.
The distinction matters when a buyer is relying on the documentation.
If you need a test report, certificate or approval reference, identify the product and its intended application. We will confirm what current documentation exists and whether it applies to your case.
